---
name: generate-ui-tests
description: Create a very small Playwright suite for valuable, stable user journeys and accessible semantics.
---
# Generate UI tests

Choose one high-value journey not already adequately covered. Use accessible roles and labels, stable data, and condition-based waits; avoid arbitrary sleeps and brittle DOM selectors. Keep the local app and Chromium prerequisites explicit. Include a keyboard/validation check when useful, but do not claim WCAG conformance from automation. Distinguish skipped tests from passes and capture the browser setup/result.
